prompt: Which fraud type is the worst?

results.text: "Worst" could mean the most confirmed loss, the most cases, or the highest false-positive rate, and fraud types do not rank the same way on each. Tell me which measure you mean, or here is loss by fraud type so you can compare.

sql.command: SELECT fraud_type, confirmed_loss_usd, false_positive_rate FROM aa_fraud_loss_summary ORDER BY confirmed_loss_usd DESC
